items.issue: README carries an operational summary, not the verbatim multi-part prompt (README says so). The verbatim text cannot be reproduced from session memory.
items.action: User to paste the verbatim prompt if required. Until then the README states the gap.

items.issue: registry/current_session.json has frozen_protocol_comparable_best: null, so the slot rule has no recorded comparator. S29 used S28-TCB HOLDOUT-DTI 0.0553736 (same evaluator) by inference.
items.action: Record a frozen comparable best before any future slot decision. No slot was used in S29.

items.issue: evidence/s25_pcse_novelty.json (51 entries) does not contain the registry-039 spacing-five lattice, so the S25 UNIQUE label excluded the registered control.
items.action: S29 re-ran the literal gate against all 87 references including registry-039. Do not rely on the S25 uniqueness label.

items.issue: Prompt cites 0.4413 as the current GEMSDOE high. Official public board fetched 2026-10-29 shows #1 xiaofanhu 0.4544 and no 0.4413 row. The 0.3195 anchor matches #47 kpomazi (another team).
items.action: Treat 0.4413 as UNVERIFIED and 0.3195 as another team's row, not a GEMSDOE result.

items.issue: S23 irregularity action said 'Do not ... optimize around holes'. S29 produced hole-constrained candidate B because the user requested a unique TIF and B passes the literal 70%/3 px rule. This conflicts with prior guidance.
items.action: B is labeled NOT OK TO SUBMIT (holdout negative, no slot). The user must decide whether such placements are acceptable before any future use.

items.issue: On gems-segment-pooled-v1 the registry-039 lattice (about 206k dots, unbudgeted) scores 0.2450, far above any budgeted candidate. The evaluator rewards dense emission; only random-K is budget-matched.
items.action: Report the lattice holdout as a dense control only. Do not use it as a benchmark for budgeted submissions.

items.issue: Candidate B passes with worst overlap 0.68 against the 0.70 limit, from a single reference (registry-039). A small change in placement could fail the rule.
items.action: Any future file must be re-gated automatically with scripts/s29_gate.py.

items.issue: The mirrored data/sample_submission.tif is not the official all-zero sample. Its 60,988 ones coincide with label positives, and existing_faults.tif is hash-identical to labels.tif. It is an unauthenticated owner mirror.
items.action: Use only for grid and nodata checks. Never use it as truth or as a values template.

items.issue: The leaderboard and S29 disclosures were requested in registry/irregularities.json, but that file is byte-pinned by the S23 run card and its historical docs copies (tests/test_s23_evidence.py). Editing it breaks a historical record.
items.action: S29 disclosures live in registry/irregularities_s29.json. registry/irregularities.json is unchanged. Re-pinning requires an explicit decision about the historical record.
